page.layout: One page: a book binding (front board), seen as a whole. The stamped design fills the board. Within it, a central panel shows an arched niche with a seated figure. Below the panel, two lines of stamped lettering sit in a small plate. No printed text block.
page.notes: This is the front cover of a binding, not a printed page. The gold-stamped border has foliate and rule ornaments. A central arched panel shows a seated figure with a book, and two small fleurons appear at the top and bottom. A dark ink stain or blot covers the upper middle of the panel. The two lines of stamped lettering at the bottom of the panel are too worn to read reliably; the fragments visible are capitals such as "...ORGEVS SVPER..." and "...AVRAM", which I cannot confirm, so I have not transcribed them. Spine bands and a stain at the lower left are visible at the edges. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
